summary: The leave-taking is a thank-you and good evening or goodnight.
realLife: Clinton in 1999 ended with thanks and good evening; Trump in 2018 with thanks, God bless America and goodnight.
sources: Read Nov 24, 2026: the first and last paragraphs of each address on the Presidency Project page; the middles were not read.
inGame: The `evening` fact exists on the inaugural and national addresses; the blessing bank has night-gated lines.

turns.what: A daytime address ends with thanks only.
